items.t: Automatic transmission slips or fails
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with remanufactured unit
items.note: Owners report $2,500-3,000 on average. A used unit costs less.

items.t: Stalls when coming to a stop
items.job: Clean throttle body and fix vacuum leaks

items.t: Runs rough in wet weather
items.job: Replace plug wires, distributor cap, rotor and spark plugs

items.t: Hood can pop open while driving (recall)
items.job: Inspect and secure hood latch
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Brake lights may not work correctly (recall)
items.job: Replace brake light switch with redesigned part
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Turn signals work only some of the time (recall)
items.job: Replace hazard switch and turn signal relay
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: ABS control unit can short and catch fire (recall)
items.job: Replace ABS control unit
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Ignition coils fail and cause misfires (recall)
items.job: Replace ignition coils and spark plugs
items.note: The old recall was free; on a car this old, expect to pay for new coils.

items.t: Driver airbag inflator may rupture (recall)
items.job: Replace driver airbag module
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Diesel fuel injectors fail
items.job: Replace pump-injector unit(s)
items.note: Owners report about $1,500 on average.

items.t: Cam follower wears through and damages the fuel pump
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pump cam follower
items.note: If the camshaft lobe is already worn, a camshaft and pump add $800-1,500 in parts.

items.t: Fuel line can chafe and leak (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace chafed fuel line
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: ABS module fails (recall on some cars)
items.job: Replace or rebuild ABS control module
items.note: Free if your car is covered by recall 16V-913. Owners report about $1,900-2,100 otherwise.

items.t: Automatic shifts poorly from valve body faults
items.job: Replace transmission valve body

items.t: Timing chain tensioner fails and wrecks the engine
items.job: Replace timing chain, tensioner and guides
items.note: Owners report $2,800 for the tensioner job and $6,600-8,000 when the engine fails.

items.t: Diesel high-pressure fuel pump fails
items.job: Replace high-pressure pump, injectors, lines and clean fuel system
items.note: Owners report about $9,500 on average when the whole fuel system is contaminated.

items.t: Driver airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
items.job: Replace driver airbag module
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Clock spring can tear and disable the driver airbag (recall)
items.job: Replace steering wheel clock spring
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Clutch slips or fails early (GTI manual)
items.job: Replace clutch kit (and flywheel if needed)
items.note: Owners report $1,800-2,300.

items.t: Water pump and thermostat housing leak coolant
items.job: Replace water pump and thermostat housing assembly

items.t: Oil leak from the timing chain cover
items.job: Reseal timing cover and cam adjuster magnets
items.note: Owners report up to $5,000 when the lower timing cover had to be replaced.

items.t: Intake camshaft adjuster fails
items.job: Replace intake camshaft with adjuster

items.t: Engine burns oil
items.job: Oil consumption test and PCV valve replacement
items.note: New pistons and rings, if needed, run several thousand dollars.

items.t: Sunroof leaks water inside
items.job: Clear and test sunroof drains
items.note: Owners report up to $5,000 when a cracked panoramic roof frame must be replaced.

items.t: Fuel can leak through the EVAP system (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel tank suction pump
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Key can come out when not in Park (recall)
items.job: Install added shifter switch and circuit board
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Front wheel bearings may be faulty (recall)
items.job: Replace front wheel bearings
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: e-Golf 12V battery not charging from DC-DC converter fault
items.job: Replace DC-DC converter
items.note: One owner was quoted about $4,800 at a dealer. Test or replace the 12V battery first ($180-300).

items.t: Backup camera goes black or freezes (recall)
items.job: Update or replace infotainment unit
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Engine cover can loosen and melt (recall)
items.job: Remove and replace engine design cover
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Radiator can damage a coolant hose (recall)
items.job: Inspect radiator mounting and replace damaged hose
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Backup camera image can be blank, delayed or missing (recall)
items.job: Replace camera or update infotainment software
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Front strut mount can deform (recall)
items.job: Replace front strut mounts
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Touch controls are hard to use and easy to press by accident
items.job: Infotainment software update
items.note: Usually done free under warranty; it does not change the hardware.

items.t: Apple CarPlay keeps disconnecting
items.job: Infotainment software update and phone re-pairing
items.note: Usually free under warranty.
